method_notes: Additive calendar-source patch built entirely from live fetches on 2026-09-20. Method: for each venue in rugby-cricket.json I identified the resident club or county club, fetched candidate calendar paths directly (/fixtures, /matches, /whats-on, /fixture/list/<id>, /fixtures-and-results and site-navigation-derived paths), and where a guessed path 404'd I fetched the site root or ran a web search to recover the real path and then fetched that. Every source_url below was fetched in this task and returned a real, correctly-identified first-party fixtures or what's-on page; URLs that 404'd, redirected to parked/unrelated domains (bristolbears.co.uk, northantscricket.com), refused connections, or turned out to be stale archive pages were discarded and are not recorded. 48 of the 67 venues are patched with 55 calendar URLs; 38 of those URLs showed dated forthcoming events at the time of checking and are marked events_currently_present true. The remaining 17 are marked false and carry an honest note: they are the club's or ground's genuine recurring fixtures page, but the fetched static HTML either was client-rendered with no rows, or listed only a completed season (many rugby league and county cricket seasons end in September, so those pages were legitimately empty of forthcoming rows on 2026-09-20). No Level 3 browser probing was used, so client-rendered pages were not forced open. Not found: leicestertigers.com returns HTTP 403 to every fetch; wiganwarriors.com, hullcityafc.com and doncasterroversfc.co.uk returned pages too large for the fetch tool to surface any rows; and several lower-tier rugby league club domains (whitehavenrl.co.uk, keighleycougars.com, northwalescrusaders.co.uk, workingtontownrlfc.com, doncasterrlfc.co.uk, barrowraiders.com, rochdalehornets.co.uk) are dead or refused connection, while batleybulldogs.co.uk, dewsburyrams.com and featherstonerovers.co.uk served empty placeholder fixtures pages. Cricket Scotland exposed no fixtures listing page at all, and cricketireland.ie/events/ returned '0 events found', with no Stormont fixture, so The Grange and Stormont are left unpatched.
